transcripts.transcript:
Hello Adrian Lim, Rachel Tan here for our arranged telephone review. Is this still a convenient time to speak?

Can. Office quite quiet now, so easier to talk. Hoping for a quiet weekend as well lah.

That sounds welcome after a busy week. Before we begin the review, please provide your identification reference and date of birth.

My FIN is F nine seven six nine five four nine Q. My date of birth is the tenth of October nineteen fifty-two. Got my notes beside me already.

Thank you. We can keep the conversation focused and leave time for anything you would like to raise at the end.

Finally got a gap between deliveries today. For this transaction, it's my holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund. I want to sell from my existing holding.

I recommend reducing your holding in Meridian Asia Equity Fund because that would lower your exposure to regional equity swings, in line with your objective. A price limit also respects your minimum acceptable sale price, although execution remains uncertain.

Having the review by phone quite convenient. No need to leave the office and rush across town lor.

Your objective is to reduce your exposure to Asian equities so your portfolio is less sensitive to regional stock-market swings. That is the priority for this review. Asian stock-market declines can reduce the value of Meridian Asia Equity Fund before your sale executes. If the available price does not meet your limit, the sale may not execute and you remain exposed to further market movements. Do you understand that the fund's value can fall before the sale, and that your price limit may leave the sale unexecuted while market exposure continues?

Yes, I understand. If the price doesn't meet my limit, still holding the fund, so its value can keep falling.

The transaction charge is 0.5% of the sale value. You could lose some or all of the capital invested in this fund, and selling may crystallise a loss. Are you willing to accept investment losses, including realising a loss on this sale to reduce your exposure?

Yes, I'm willing to accept investment losses and realise a loss to reduce my exposure. But keep to my price limit, ah. Use euros for this transaction. The transaction amount I want is 25,000. The quantity is 250 units. Make it a limit order, with a minimum sale price of 100 euros per unit. Below that, don't execute, ah.

Please confirm your final instruction: sell 250 units of Meridian Asia Equity Fund, with a transaction amount of 25,000 in euros, using a limit order at a minimum sale price of 100 euros per unit. Do you authorise me to place that instruction?

Yes, I confirm that final instruction as you've just stated it. Please place the order. Nothing else from my side lah.

Thank you, Adrian Lim. I'll attend to the administration now. I hope you enjoy a peaceful weekend, and thank you for making time for the call.

Thanks, Rachel Tan. Staying home sounds good after this week. No big plans, just hoping the office phone stays quiet for a change.

I hope it does. Enjoy the break. Goodbye.
